author: 1v1Me_
body:
The Truth...
So I really love this server and I am really sick right now, I have written many appeals and I hope this one shall be my last. Every day I go on Skype and get asked to play avicus or mineplex with my friends. They always play avicus more and I am stuck playing by myself on another server. I really miss avicus, 

So the truth is, I bought this account from someone who had an account already (WhackaFlackaFlame), He was a good friend so i thought why not, The game seemed fun from when i watched him, So i payed him 5 bucks and I thought it was mine. He got banned a few months later, He seemed pretty pissed but I thought, who cares. He started then using my account I bought from him. It got banned and so did one of my brothers. My other brother is what we call an ultra hacker. He doesn't play mine craft without hacking. He has been hacking on every server he can. He started to hack on avicus and got banned after I got banned coincidentally. You can leave Bridge__ banned, cause he actually hacks, But please consider unbanning me and my brother. 

Thank you for your time 
-1v1Me_
